source: EU-DEM 25 m (Copernicus) through the Open Topo Data API, sampled every 0.002 degrees (about 140 m east-west, 220 m north-south) on 28 October 2026; one isolated spike removed. Villages from Wikipedia, the US NGA gazetteer and the Mills Archive; the Ligny brook traced from the heights between them; roads, and the places marked est in ligny.geojson, are estimated from written descriptions (no period map traced)
